title: Techniques of Radio News Writting and Production
modules: Understanding Basic Concepts In Radio News
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the procedure that the station went through to create a finished product of a show."
Production is the procedure that the station went through to create a finished product of a show.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a microphone hung on clothing at the leg of participants in a radio show."
Lavalier is a microphone hung on clothing at the leg of participants in a radio show.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement, often written which is put forward for the accomplishment of a task."
A programme proposal is a statement, often written which is put forward for the accomplishment of a task.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a perfect example of news sources."
Interview is a perfect example of news sources.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the engine that drives the media."
Advertising is the engine that drives the media.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a necessary component of all electronic devices such as cell phones, radio stations etc 6."
The transmitter is a necessary component of all electronic devices such as cell phones, radio stations etc 6.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of distributing television shows according to the hour of the day and the length of each show."
Programming is the process of distributing television shows according to the hour of the day and the length of each show.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a setup that is made to be used by one individual."
Self-operation or self-op studio refers to a setup that is made to be used by one individual.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a highly essential source of news as well."
Press conferences are a highly essential source of news as well.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as the report's cue or lead-in."
The voicer's opening sentence is referred to as the report's cue or lead-in.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the elements of radio production. viii."
Studio is one of the elements of radio production. viii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an electronic device that receives signals and radio waves that are transmitted by the transmitter. 8."
Receiver is an electronic device that receives signals and radio waves that are transmitted by the transmitter. 8.

Defining Radio Production Production simply means to produce, create, or package an idea into a consumable product for people to have access to.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a criminal offence in academics and is highly penalised."
Plagiarism is a criminal offence in academics and is highly penalised.
